changes: Title pages no longer pause or stick while their copies are counted: the counting runs behind the page now, copies join the list as they land, and a page can always be scrolled and left
A show and a later remake of it under the same name now stand as two shows, each with its own seasons and its own page, while a show whose seasons were posted under different years stays one show
Free up space now quotes only what clearing can actually free: pictures and posters are counted where they lie on the phone, so the promised space matches the space you get
notes: Title pages that never stick, remakes standing apart from the shows they remake, and honest Free up space figures.
